tasks_completed.description: AC6 regression fix: decouple Accommodation Section gate from primary accommodation. Section now renders when EITHER day.accommodation OR day.accommodation_jade is non-empty.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA iteration 1 found that suppressing Matilde 自行安排 phantom (BUG-G fix) made primary day.accommodation null on Days 9-14, which collapsed the entire Accommodation Section, taking accommodation_jade with it. Result: Jade's home (自如寓·五道口店) and her booked Shanghai 珍宝酒店 (¥698) became invisible. Surgical 2-line edit decouples the conditional. The primary card renders only if day.accommodation exists; the jade card always renders if day.accommodation_jade exists; the Section wrapper renders if either is present.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Cycle-1 dev edits to scripts/generate-html-interactive.py (BUG-G accommodation fix) made primary acc null on Days 9-14 but did not update the Section's conditional gate that depended on day.accommodation being truthy
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: BUG-G fix only addressed the data side (out_of_scope flag) and the primary-card render guard, but missed the outermost Section gate at line 2643. The accommodation_jade rendering was nested INSIDE the Section, so when the Section gate evaluated false, the jade card was never reached.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Move the gate from `day.accommodation` to `(day.accommodation || day.accommodation_jade)` at line 2643. Convert the primary-card iteration from `[day.accommodation].map` (which would crash on null) to `(day.accommodation ? [day.accommodation] : []).map` so the primary card cleanly omits when null. The jade-card render block (line 2681) was already inside the Section and remains untouched.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: N/A — this IS the minimum possible diff (2 line modifications). No new functions, helpers, classes, or CSS introduced. No refactors. Surgical decoupling of an existing conditional.
